name: Israel Ilori
title: Data & AI Lead
description: Israel Ilori is a Data & AI Lead in Vancouver who builds data platforms and production machine learning systems that people use to make decisions.
intro: I build data, machine learning and AI systems that people use to make decisions: who to show an ad to, where an advertiser is overpaying, where public money is being spent. I start from the business question, build the data and models that answer it, and see them through to production and adoption.
about: Right now I work in Ads Intelligence at Aylo, on a high-volume advertising platform. I built the bid tracking pipeline our product team uses to see who wins each auction and why, designed a bid recommendation system on top of it, and improved our click-prediction model and the service that runs it. Before that, at the BC Public Service, I led a data management platform that brought C$1.5 billion in telecom spend across thirteen public-sector entities into one governed view.

Earlier I trained transformer models for threat and misinformation detection at Logically, built search and data pipelines at HelpSeeker, and started out as a data analyst in banking. I mentor students in UBC's Master of Data Science program, and in January 2027 I start the Professional MBA at UBC Sauder, because the problems I care about most are now as much about strategy and teams as about technology.

experience.summary: Built the daily bid tracking pipeline the product team uses to guide bid pricing, and designed a bid recommendation system on its findings. Improved the click-prediction model and made the service faster with more capacity using ONNX and async FastAPI on Kubernetes. Built a CLIP model that predicts ad-image clickability, a Moondream2 image-understanding service, and the team's first agentic AI assistant. Now building a smart alerting service that turns the many alerts one outage triggers into a single clear alert.

Led the Data Management Platform for C$1.5B in telecom spend across 13 entities, automating reporting that would otherwise have needed 7 more analysts. Event-driven ETL on AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Athena) with Terraform and Power BI reporting for leadership. As the only technical member of a team of 2, I taught data concepts in plain language so the team could read dashboards and explain spend on their own.
Python ETL and Airflow pipelines for the Karto platform, and a document similarity model deployed on Kubernetes for search.
Led ML upgrades to the Logically Intelligence platform that raised threat-detection accuracy by 32%, rebuilt transformer classification pipelines, and ran MLOps on GCP.
Designed the NLP matching system that ranked candidates against job descriptions, working directly with the founders.
Dashboards for senior management in Tableau and Power BI, and financial trend analysis in Python and SQL.
